trades.name: Tempus AI, Inc.
trades.analysis: TEM is currently near the 0.5-0.618 Fibonacci retracement zone, calculated from its recent six-month swing between $41.55 and $61.6. The stock is trading above its 20-day and 50-day moving averages, indicating an established uptrend, although current relative volume is below average. A bounce from this Fibonacci zone could offer a potential entry, with a stop placed below significant support.

trades.name: Microsoft Corp.

trades.name: NVIDIA Corporation
